enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe regularly. Turn again. Pull blanket down slightly. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Turn to back. Breathe slowly. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to side.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Dry face. Take off pajamas. Put on work clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making a hot drink with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Cook eggs. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into cup. Sit and eat breakfast. Drink tea. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, checking phone messages and reviewing the day's patient schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open work bag. Place items into bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Read messages. Reply to messages. Review patient schedule. Place phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read news. Listen to music. Signal for stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, medication rounds and clinical record keeping
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Change into scrubs. Attend handover meeting. Review patient charts. Visit patient room. Greet patient. Check patient ID. Take vital signs. Assess patient condition. Administer medications. Update patient records. Coordinate with colleagues. Attend to patient call. Assist with patient mobility. Clean equipment. Document care plans. Consult with doctor. Prepare medication for next round. Review lab results. End shift handover.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital staff area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff area. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out food. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash. Return to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties: patient care, coordinating with colleagues and updating care plans
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient list. Visit patient rooms. Assist with patient hygiene. Change wound dressings. Administer IV medications. Monitor patient vitals. Respond to patient calls. Consult with doctors. Update care plans. Coordinate with nurses. Attend team meeting. Document patient progress. Prepare patient for tests. Escort patient to radiology. Collect lab samples. Clean and sterilize equipment. Restock supplies. Review medication orders. Educate patient on medication. Prepare handover notes.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone messages. Listen to music. Look out window. Signal for stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to home. Unlock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Splash water on face. Dry face.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat to pan. Stir meat. Add vegetables to pan. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load utensils. Load glasses. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Put cloth away.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and browsing on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select program. Put down remote. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open web browser. Browse internet. Check social media. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up remote. Change channel. Put down remote. Close laptop. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down: watching TV and setting an alarm on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on TV. Sit on bed. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off TV. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Pull blanket up. Remain still.

Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe regularly. Turn again. Pull blanket down slightly. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Turn to back. Breathe slowly. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to side.
